changelog.notes: PVS mother trial exported as companion data to the India tricot trials, in the layout of release schema v2.0. PVS trials have no rankings.

study.title: Bread wheat PVS mother trial in India (Uttar Pradesh), rabi 2015-16
study.description: Participatory varietal selection (PVS) mother trial of bread wheat in India (Uttar Pradesh), rabi 2015-16 season. Researcher-managed plots on host farms, one plot per variety, with measured agronomic traits and yield and no farmer rankings. Published as companion data to the tricot trials of the same crop, season and district.

companion_of.link: same crop and season; same state, shared villages (adm3), district not recorded

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites linked to a tricot site reuse that site's published point. Sites without GPS take the mean of tricot farms in the same district and village before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised
location_privacy.gap_filling: Sites without a point take the mean of located sites with the same administrative names, pooled across all published trials (adm2+adm3, then adm3, then adm2, within 30 km of their mean), before rounding. coordinate_source names the level, coordinate_uncertainty_m adds the spread of the pool.

genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Early sowing, resistant to high temperature at seedling stage

genotypes.recommended_zone: Central (MP, Chhatishgarh, Gujrat, Kota & Udaipur divisions of Rajasthan)  and Penninsular (Maharastra and Karnataka) zones
genotypes.biotic_resistance: Adult plant resistance against brown and yellow rust

genotypes.recommended_zone: North Western and North Eastern Plain Zone
genotypes.biotic_resistance: It possesses very high adult plant resistance against most prevalent leaf rust disease as well as of 78S84 and 46S119 two most virulent races of yellow rust disease. It has also better degree of resistance against leaf blight
